Addiction and alcohol use disorders look different from one person to the next, so treatment should be matched to need rather than forced into a single program. We can help connect you with a full continuum of care that meets you where you are and changes as you progress.

Medical Detox

Supervised stabilization for the first days of withdrawal. Severe alcohol or benzodiazepine withdrawal can be dangerous and generally needs medical oversight.

Residential Treatment

PHP & IOP

Day treatment and intensive outpatient programs that allow you to step down in intensity while staying engaged in life at home.

Outpatient & Aftercare

h1: Drug & Alcohol Rehab Serving Santa Clarita, California
bodyHtml:
Santa Clarita is one of the largest cities in Los Angeles County, spread across the northern part of the county where the I-5 and SR-14 freeways converge. Its communities — including Valencia, Newhall, Canyon Country, and Saugus — are home to hundreds of thousands of residents who commute across the region, raise families, and build careers in a growing suburban landscape. When substance use becomes a problem, the distance from downtown behavioral health infrastructure and the pressure to appear fine can make asking for help harder than it should be. California Treatment Centers serves Santa Clarita residents and connects them with evidence-based addiction treatment at our California programs.

Addiction in the Santa Clarita Valley

Like the rest of greater Los Angeles, Santa Clarita sees the full range of substance use challenges — alcohol, opioids, methamphetamine, prescription medications, and more. Suburban environments carry their own pressures: long commutes on the 5 freeway, financial stress, social isolation, and limited access to visible behavioral health services. Reaching out takes courage, and a confidential, no-pressure call is all it takes to start understanding your options.

Levels of Care We Offer

Treatment outcomes improve when care is matched to clinical need. We help Santa Clarita residents access a full continuum:

  • Medical detox — supervised withdrawal management for alcohol, opioids, benzodiazepines, and other substances. Severe alcohol and benzodiazepine withdrawal can be dangerous and requires medical supervision; it should never be attempted alone.
  • Residential treatment — 24/7 structured, live-in care with daily therapy and clinical support.
  • Partial hospitalization (PHP) — intensive daytime clinical programming with the flexibility to sleep off-site or in structured housing.
  • Intensive outpatient (IOP) — structured group and individual therapy several days per week, compatible with work, school, and family responsibilities.
  • General outpatient — regular therapy at a lower frequency as recovery stabilizes.
  • Sober living — supportive, peer-based housing for people transitioning out of residential or PHP.

What We Treat

Our programs address a wide range of substance use conditions, including alcohol, opioids and fentanyl, methamphetamine, cocaine, benzodiazepines, and prescription drugs. Many people also carry co-occurring conditions — anxiety, depression, or trauma — alongside substance use, and our programs are designed to treat both together.

Alcohol

Structured care for alcohol dependence, including medically supervised detox when physical withdrawal risk is present.

Opioids & Fentanyl

Medication-assisted treatment and behavioral therapy for opioid and fentanyl use disorders.

Methamphetamine

Evidence-based behavioral care for meth use, which is prevalent across the greater Los Angeles region.

Co-Occurring

Dual diagnosis treatment addresses mental health and substance use conditions together.

Insurance & Verification

California Treatment Centers is in-network with most major insurers. We offer free, confidential insurance verification so you understand your coverage before making any decisions. Many Santa Clarita residents are surprised by how much their plan covers. You can verify your insurance online or by phone at any time.

How to Get Started

Your first call is private and carries no obligation. Our admissions team listens, explains your options clearly, and coordinates the path forward — from a benefit check to scheduling and, when residential or detox is the right starting point, a smooth hand-off into care. Call 213-321-6518 whenever you are ready. If you or a loved one is in crisis, call or text 988 for free, 24/7 support. The SAMHSA National Helpline at 1-800-662-4357 also provides free, confidential treatment referrals around the clock.

faq.q: Do you serve residents of Santa Clarita?
faq.a: Yes. We serve Santa Clarita residents and help connect people across the Santa Clarita Valley with California Treatment Centers programs. Call 213-321-6518 and our team will explain the closest and most appropriate options for your situation.

faq.q: What levels of care are available for Santa Clarita residents?
faq.a: We help Santa Clarita-area clients access medical detox, residential treatment, partial hospitalization (PHP), intensive outpatient (IOP), general outpatient, and sober living.

faq.q: Is alcohol withdrawal dangerous?
faq.a: Alcohol withdrawal can be life-threatening in cases of physical dependence. Symptoms such as severe anxiety, tremors, and seizures can develop without medical supervision. If someone is dependent on alcohol, stopping alone is not safe — medical detox with clinical oversight is strongly recommended.

faq.q: Does insurance cover rehab for Santa Clarita residents?
faq.a: We are in-network with most major insurers and offer free, confidential verification of benefits. Your exact coverage depends on your specific plan, which we confirm at no cost before you commit to anything.

faq.q: What if I also have a mental health condition?
faq.a: Co-occurring mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, or trauma are very common alongside substance use. Our programs are designed to address both together through integrated dual diagnosis treatment.
